title: Can I BEAT Magnus with 1 Piece?
summary: Player (white) faces the Magnus bot (~2800) with only the king plus ONE piece, upgrading the piece after each loss: pawn -> queen -> Amazon (queen+knight) -> nightrider -> nuke (queen+nightrider). Each lone piece gets trapped or traded by Magnus's coordinated army (pawn blocked and taken; queen traded, ladder mate; Amazon forced trade; nightrider lost; nuke trapped and mated). Lost every game.
rules: Player white: king + one piece; Magnus bot black: full army.
Piece sequence after each loss: pawn, queen, Amazon (Q+N), nightrider (repeated knight leaps), nuke (Q + nightrider).
Nuke here is just a strong mover (no explosion).
win_condition: Checkmate Magnus with the single piece. Video: lost all five.
